title: Tuli Tuipulotu continues his training camp hold in as he chases new Chargers deal

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tuli Tuipulotu continues his training camp hold in as he chases new Chargers deal
sources.description: Chargers fourth-year pass rusher Tuli Tuipulotu is holding in at training camp in search of a new contract. Khalil Mack and Derwin James offer their support.
